live.note: Per-precinct votes for every contest on the ballot, from the county's cast vote record — one anonymised record per ballot. Choices on ballots traceable to an individual voter are redacted by law (2 CCR 20126) and are absent here. Per-precinct registration and turnout are not published yet, so turnout is unavailable. Superseded by the certified Statement of Vote.

_cvr.note: Built from a Dominion CVR export. A record is one CARD, not one ballot, so 'ballots_cast' is the busiest contest's card count in that precinct, not a session count. 'registered' is unknown to a CVR and is 0. Everything here reflects ballots PROCESSED at export time, not final turnout. Cards whose choices were redacted under 2 CCR 20126 are counted in 'cast' and in 'redacted', never as votes or undervotes.
